title: Treat Them Right
subtitle: For your safety, do not accept invitations from strangers to visit their homes.

items.text: Not far away, Jiǔ Niángzǐ can be seen stopping near the post where the animals were tied, vaguely moving as if whispering something to them.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Um, can you understand me?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Can you tell me where you are from?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Hello ...
Yenisei waits for a moment before walking forward and attempting to pat her shoulder.
The girl turns around to reveal her young and eager face.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Hmm? What's wrong? I don't know you. Have we met before?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: I don't think so. We just arrived here.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Really? Oh, welcome to Pèi City!
Yenisei cannot help but hold her eyes on the bundled hemp rope the girl is holding in her hand, and the many animals now tied at the end of it.
Jiǔ Niángzǐ blinks, then blinks again, as though realizing what the other girl is staring at.
A blush quickly rises to her cheeks like two sunset clouds.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Oh ... Y-you were on the street, weren't you?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: I am so sorry. I didn't mean to make such a scene there. I promise, it was just an accident!

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: I can imagine. You reacted quickly and saved us from more trouble.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: No, no, no, it was my responsibility. And the people on the street also gave me a hand there!

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: How can I help you? Please feel free to let me know.
She seems to be a warm-hearted type.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Here's the case: The people call you Jiǔ Niángzǐ, and you work in the Zhící, right?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Ng, ng. Yes!

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Lǐzhèng told us to find you, and we happened to hear your conversation on the street.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: So did the feather man come here today?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Feather man? You mean the Xiángruì out of the city? Um, I heard that he had been here. As for today, I have no idea.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: What about the animals in the fence? Any new ones?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: I-I'm not sure about that either. When I arrived at the Zhící this morning, there were already many Festive Animals in the fence.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: They're getting more and more ... How weird is that!
Jiǔ Niángzǐ mutters inaudibly before turning around, pointing out the culprits who caused her so much trouble earlier with her index finger.

Yenisei inspects the creatures briefly but doesn't seem to notice any difference. It seems to be a show for common livestock, where various cattle, sheep, and horses might compete to show their worth.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: See, they all look alike. I can't tell which of them were brought here today. Counting is troublesome as well. I always think, "where am I?"

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: If only I could read and write. You write them down, then you won't miscount.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Our teammates have been turned into striped horses, like these.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Actually, we are a team of merchants. When we reached the outskirts of the city, our teammates were turned into horses and brought away by a giant bird.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Lǐzhèng said that bird was probably the feather man they've been looking for, and he appeared around the Zhící once.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: That's why we are here to ask for help.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: They're-They're not horses, I suppose.
Jiǔ Niángzǐ seems hesitant to say anything further.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: But-but how is that possible? Are you saying that the feather man can turn people into ... into horses ...?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: I don't understand. How did he get this power? Is it because he is the Xiángruì?
Upon hearing the word "Xiángruì" again, Bessmert's interest is immediately captured.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: We've also heard about the Xiángruì from the Storyteller. It does sound like some kind of local guardian.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Guardian? Is it the Gods of Shètí we're talking about?

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: Oh, yes, the Gods of Shètí. These are the gods you serve.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: I guess Xiángruì is closer to a local legend, like a reputed arcanist in this area. The use of arcane skills seems common here. Perhaps there are also many arcanists around.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: But, could you please tell us more about the Gods of Shètí?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: There are 12 ... or 13 of them, I guess? That's all I know. I can't read most of their names.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Oh, but I know this year is the year of Zhíxú! We will bring lots of Festive Animals to the broken bridge to worship It.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: The Fortune Walk and Bridge Leap are the most fun parts! We go to the broken bridge on the cliff with the animals, count our steps, and swing our bodies, like dancing. And at last, we will try to jump over it!

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Jump over a broken bridge on the cliff? It sounds dangerous and quite ... familiar.
Bessmert knows exactly what Yenisei is hinting at. The familiar rule of "Ask and Acquire" resurfaces in their minds, but no one attempts to ask it out loud.
So that Jiǔ Niángzǐ's explanation interrupts their thoughts with perfect timing.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: No, no, no, we can't do that. No one has even done that! Even the goats can't do that, let alone humans.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: We'll also cast arcane skills as safety measures to protect anyone from falling.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: The valley is deeeep down there. Once you fall down, you're not coming back.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: Intriguing. And who's in charge of the safety measures, may I ask?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: The staff in the Zhící. It's the place to manage arcane affairs in the Pèi City.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: But not me ... I'm new here, filling in for the former Zhílǐ after she went back to her hometown.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: They told me to take care of Zhící for a couple of days. That's good enough for me!
Her eagerness to be able to help is clear.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: So, simply put, you're a doorkeeper?
The barb of her conclusion makes Jiǔ Niángzǐ fluster into a red blush.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: I-I'm not-I'm not just keeping the door safe! I do stuff too!

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Like, um, take good care of those startled by the fire crackers! There is a kind of firecracker enhanced by arcane skill. It can make a huuuge sound! Much more louder than what you heard in the tea house!

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: Please forgive her. She didn't mean to hurt your feelings. We speak bluntly in the North.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Oh, it's alright. I can tell she's a bit anxious.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: But it's not getting us anywhere. Like, um, pigs can't learn how to climb in a day ...

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Or, let's think another way. Can you recognize your teammates from these horses?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Let me see, there are one, two, three ... three striped horses. Come see for yourself.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: I can't. There was little time for me to memorize the difference. Besides, even if they are my teammates, two of them are still missing.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: More than three teammates?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: When three plus two ...
Jiǔ Niángzǐ counts out the numbers on her fingers, calculating with great care.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: How about we wait and see what Lǐzhèng has found out?

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: That's right, child, didn't Lǐzhèng leave us with a letter?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Oh, right. I almost forgot. Please read this, Ms. Jiǔ Niángzǐ. It may have clues about the feather man.
She produces the letter, offering it to the girl.
Jiǔ Niángzǐ opens it in front of them without a moment's hesitation, but all Yenisei can see on it are several images.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Um ...

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Make the fence taller ... Get off work earlier and ... go back to the tavern?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: What is he trying to say?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: What do these have to do with the feather man?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Hmm?
Jiǔ Niángzǐ mutters to herself as she stares at the pictures on the letter, before frowning and smoothing it out. She clumsily folds it and clips it to her waist.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Well, don't worry! I'll pay close attention to the new horses for you!

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: If there's any good news, I'll ask Lǐzhèng to tell you.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: You're so kind. But we just got here and haven't decided where to stay for the night. How are we going to keep Lǐzhèng informed once we find a place to rest?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Oh ... I see ...
An answer leaps to her mind, bursting through and out at the same time.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: How about staying in my tavern? I forgot to tell you that I'm the owner of a tavern.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: And I'm doing it well!
She laughs, as though just the saying of it might render it true.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: It is located in the merchants hub, two streets away from the Zhící. Lǐzhèng will know your whereabouts since he's in charge of the hub.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: I'll take you back to the tavern, also escort these animals back to the Zhící. You can check out other animals there as well!

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Good idea.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: That'd be great. Saves us from all the trouble sleeping on the streets.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Let's go then. Oh, the street looks beautiful later in the night. You can't miss the golden lanterns and bonfires lit on Dùshuò Festival! They light up the sky and the street as if it's daytime.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Everything seems brighter at night.
